description:
The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) launched the International Collaboration scheme in 2016. 

This initiative aims to promote international collaboration in social science research. 

The scheme seeks to enhance the quality of research by fostering partnerships with foreign institutions. 

The ICSSR International Collaboration scheme is designed to support Indian researchers in engaging with global scholars. 

The primary objective is to facilitate joint research projects between Indian and foreign researchers. 

The scheme also aims to promote the exchange of ideas and methodologies in social science research. 

It encourages Indian researchers to participate in international conferences and workshops. 

The ICSSR aims to strengthen the global presence of Indian social science research. 

The scheme has specific measurable targets. 

It aims to support at least 100 international collaborations annually. 

The expected outcome is to publish at least 50 joint research papers in reputed international journals each year. 

The benefits of the ICSSR International Collaboration scheme include financial assistance. 

The scheme provides up to INR 5 lakh for each approved project. 

This funding can cover travel expenses for researchers. 

It can also support the costs of organizing workshops and conferences. 

The financial assistance is provided in two installments. 

The first installment is released upon approval of the project. 

The second installment is released upon submission of the final report. 

Eligibility for the scheme is limited to researchers affiliated with recognized Indian institutions. 

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. degree in social sciences. 

They must also have a minimum of five years of research experience. 

The scheme is open to researchers from various disciplines within social sciences. 

This includes sociology, economics, political science, and anthropology. 

The application process involves several specific steps. 

Interested researchers must submit a detailed project proposal. 

The proposal should outline the objectives and expected outcomes of the collaboration. 

It must also include a budget breakdown for the requested funding. 

Applicants are required to provide a letter of intent from the foreign collaborator. 

This letter should confirm the willingness to engage in the proposed project. 

The completed application must be submitted online through the ICSSR website. 

The deadline for submission is typically set for the end of March each year. 

The review process takes approximately three months. 

Successful applicants are notified by the end of June. 

The disbursement of funds occurs shortly after the approval notification. 

The ICSSR collaborates with various international institutions. 

These include universities and research organizations across the globe. 

The scheme has facilitated partnerships with institutions in the USA, UK, and Australia. 

The ICSSR also promotes participation in international conferences. 

Researchers can apply for funding to attend conferences abroad. 

The maximum funding for conference attendance is INR 1 lakh. 

This funding can cover registration fees and travel expenses. 

The application for conference funding follows a similar process. 

Researchers must submit a proposal detailing the conference and its relevance. 

The ICSSR evaluates applications based on the quality of the proposed research. 

The scheme has seen a significant increase in applications since its inception. 

In 2016, the ICSSR received 50 applications. 

By 2022, this number had increased to over 200 applications annually. 

The success rate for funding has remained around 30 percent. 

The ICSSR has also established partnerships with various international funding agencies. 

These collaborations enhance the scope and reach of the scheme. 

The ICSSR International Collaboration scheme is part of a broader initiative. 

It aligns with the Indian government's goal of enhancing research quality. 

The scheme supports the vision of making India a global research hub. 

The ICSSR also organizes workshops to promote awareness of the scheme. 

These workshops are conducted in various regions across India. 

They aim to educate researchers about the application process and eligibility criteria. 

The ICSSR provides a dedicated helpline for queries related to the scheme. 

Researchers can contact the helpline for assistance with their applications. 

The contact details are available on the ICSSR website. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the research community. 

Many researchers have reported enhanced collaboration and networking opportunities. 

The ICSSR International Collaboration scheme continues to evolve. 

It adapts to the changing landscape of global research collaboration. 

The scheme is instrumental in promoting India's social science research on the international stage. 

It aims to build a sustainable framework for ongoing international partnerships. 

The ICSSR encourages interdisciplinary research through this scheme. 

Researchers from different fields are encouraged to collaborate. 

This approach fosters innovation and diverse perspectives in research. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of research impact. 

It encourages researchers to focus on real-world applications of their findings. 

The ICSSR aims to bridge the gap between academia and policy-making. 

The scheme is a vital component of India's research ecosystem. 

It plays a crucial role in enhancing the visibility of Indian researchers globally. 

The ICSSR International Collaboration scheme is a testament to India's commitment to research excellence. 

It reflects the government's dedication to fostering a vibrant research culture. 

The scheme is expected to continue growing in the coming years. 

It aims to further increase the number of international collaborations. 

The ICSSR is committed to supporting researchers in their endeavors. 

The scheme is a valuable resource for social science researchers in India. 

It provides the necessary funding and support for impactful research. 

The ICSSR International Collaboration scheme is a significant step towards global academic engagement. 

It empowers Indian researchers to contribute to global knowledge production. 

The scheme ultimately aims to enhance the quality of life through informed research.
